title: Oven Roasted Canadian Salmon Papillote
description: A romantic Canadian dish featuring salmon, hojicha, and crispy elements, all cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven, inspired by the umami flavors of the sea and the simplicity of a papillote

ingredients.name: parchment paper
ingredients.notes: large enough to wrap each salmon piece

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together hojicha tea leaves, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, dashi powder if using, salt, and black pepper.
Place a salmon fillet in the center of each parchment paper sheet.
Brush the hojicha mixture evenly over both sides of each salmon fillet.
Fold the parchment paper over each salmon fillet to create a papillote, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the papillotes in a large Dutch oven, leaving some space between each packet.
Bake the salmon in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the salmon from the oven and let it rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
